eventTime.meaning: Reported calendar day, not a confidence interval.

structure.note: Catalog PAYLOAD class alone does not establish physical intactness near reentry.

debrisOrigin.note: No collision, fragmentation, or other origin classification established by these inputs.

parentNoradIds.note: No parent-object link established by these inputs.

physicalSize.note: No sourced dimensions or mass in the selected inputs.

radarSize.note: Radar size class; not diameter or mass.

orbitNearEvent.meaning: Mean-element descriptors at the source epoch, not exact values at reentry.

orbitRegimeNearEvent.note: Example rule: both perigee and apogee are positive and below 2000 km at the selected epoch.

orbitRegimeLifetime.note: Only a four-day terminal history window was queried; lifetime classification not established.

eventLocation.note: Reentry geography is not constrained to a point or region by these inputs.

coordinates.note: Site-code lookup has not been added; this is not a reentry location.

catalogCountry.note: Catalog attribution, distinct from institutional ownership.

owner.note: Not established by the selected records.

operator.note: Not established by the selected records.

functionalStatus.note: No event-time operational state established by these inputs.

reentryControl.note: No sourced controlled/uncontrolled determination in the selected records.

presentation.anchorPolicy: UTC noon within reported day; matches existing timeline
presentation.timeMapping: Replay source geometry around the shared display anchor; do not rewrite source sample timestamps.
presentation.styleMeaning: Available attribute mappings, not yet assigned. Marker width may be exaggerated.

sourceElementAgeAtReportedDecayHours.meaning: Age during reported calendar day; not a propagation accuracy bound; upper end exclusive.

sampledRadiusMinusReferenceKm.meaning: Model sample range; not true-altitude uncertainty or mean-element perigee/apogee.

reentryLocation.meaning: Unknown; do not generate a factual point location.

diagnostics.meaning: Sensitivity between element sets, not a calibrated error radius.
